categories.name: Scale journeys
ideas: A lantern diver and a silver needle fall from a cloud harbour into a glowing trench until the needle stitches the dark shut.
A seed courier and a glass compass climb a redwood that opens into a coastline until the compass points at the sun.
A kite mason and a chalk plumb rise from a courtyard well to the lip of a thunderhead until the plumb finds still air.
A pearl swimmer and a tiny bell descend a waterfall that widens into a sea until the bell rings the surface calm.
A moth cartographer and a brass astrolabe cross a pollen desert that shrinks to a windowsill until the astrolabe names the room.
A frost pilot and a paper wing glide from an ice cathedral down to one frozen leaf until the wing melts a path.
A coral singer and a gold thimble travel a reef that towers into a city until the thimble hems the tide.
A dust astronomer and a crystal lens walk a dune that opens into the night sky until the lens catches dawn.
A bubble architect and an iron seed float from a teacup storm up to a glass mountain until the seed roots the cloud.
A firefly surveyor and a silk thread measure a canyon of mirrors down to a door of light until the thread ties it open.

categories.name: Fluid motion
ideas: An ink shepherd and a porcelain bowl pour a river through a marble plaza until the bowl drinks the river back.
A tide tailor and a copper bobbin stitch moonlight into a harbour until the bobbin spools the waves still.
A rain sommelier and a clear vial catch a storm inside a greenhouse until the vial ferments the thunder sweet.
A mercury dancer and a black ribbon cross a ballroom of meltwater until the ribbon freezes one perfect turn.
A fog ferryman and a lantern coil guide a lake through a cedar grove until the coil brightens the far shore.
A syrup astronomer and a spinning spoon map a caramel sea inside a lighthouse until the spoon finds the horizon.
A tear-glass blower and a hollow reed shape a waterfall in a sunken chapel until the reed sings it upward.
A mist gardener and a silver watering can walk a cloud orchard until the can rains fruit into open hands.
An oil-lamp sailor and a cork compass drift a kitchen flood out to a moonlit bay until the compass points home.
A snowmelt painter and a horsehair brush draw a glacier across a ballroom until the brush thaws a dance floor.

categories.name: Organic change
ideas: A bloom keeper and a bone flute turn a winter orchard into a living cathedral until the flute calls the leaves in.
A mycelium tailor and a spore needle sew a coat of moss across a stone amphitheatre until the needle rests.
A chrysalis pilot and a silk map hatch inside a clocktower until the map unfolds into wings.
A root architect and a copper acorn lift a cottage into a walking grove until the acorn plants the door.
A pollen priest and a gold saucer bless a field that becomes a choir until the saucer catches the song.
A fossil gardener and a soft hammer wake a sleeping reef under a meadow until the hammer rings it gentle.
A vine clockmaker and a green gear grow a timepiece through a library until the gear blooms on the hour.
A feather alchemist and a clay egg turn a cliff roost into a garden of flight until the egg cracks into dawn.
A bark singer and a resin bow play a forest until the bow draws the trees into one slow curve.
A seed librarian and a dew stamp file a jungle into a single drawer until the stamp opens a skylight of leaves.

categories.name: Bright weather
ideas: A sun cooper and a lemon bell forge noon inside a hill town until the bell rings every shadow kind.
A kite physician and a ribbon thermometer heal a grey harbour with a laughing squall until the ribbon warms.
A blossom postman and a wicker satchel deliver dawn along a canal until the satchel spills light on the water.
A rainbow mechanic and a prism wrench tune a waterfall over a fairground until the wrench locks a clean arc.
A honey pilot and a straw compass fly a meadow through a town square until the compass points at laughter.
A confetti meteorologist and a paper barometer call a storm of petals over a pier until the sky clears bright.
A daisy diver and a cork crown swim a sunlit quarry until the crown floats the whole afternoon.
A breeze conductor and a wheat baton lead a valley orchestra until the baton rests in warm hands.
A lantern baker and a sunrise loaf open a night bakery onto a brilliant street until the loaf glows.
A spark gardener and a glass trowel plant stars in a daytime fountain until the trowel strikes joy.

categories.name: Night hush
ideas: An eclipse warden and a velvet key lock the sun inside a coastal fort until the key leaves one star free.
An ash gardener and a coal watering can tend a garden of embers under a viaduct until the can sighs cool.
A hush diver and a lead bell sink through a black lake under a chapel until the bell makes a soft answer.
A moth archivist and a soot ledger catalogue a burnt theatre until the ledger remembers one bright cue.
A frost nun and an iron candle keep vigil in a snow quarry until the candle steadies the dark.
A shadow ferryman and an obsidian coin cross a river of ink under a dead pier until the coin pays for dawn.
An owl mason and a moon hammer build a silent nave in a pine ravine until the hammer sets the last dark stone.
A smoke librarian and a charred bookmark wander a flooded stack until the bookmark finds an unburnt page.
A tide mourner and a black locket walk a moonless strand until the locket opens onto a small warm light.
A cavern painter and a phosphorescent brush draw a sleeping city on a cave sea until the brush finally rests.

categories.name: Joyful machines
ideas: A clockwork gardener and a singing gear grow a carousel in a citrus grove until the gear laughs the ride awake.
A balloon engineer and a brass whistle launch a parade from a rooftop orchard until the whistle calls it home.
A typewriter pilot and a ribbon propeller fly a greeting across a sunny aqueduct until the propeller signs the sky.
A music-box diver and a pearl crank swim a harbour of buoys until the crank winds the tide into a tune.
A tram poet and a golden bell-pull ring a city into a dance along a flower viaduct until the pull rests.
An automaton baker and a yeast compass proof joy in a glass factory until the compass points at the warm oven.
A bicycle astronomer and a spoke harp ride a coastal road until the harp strums the afternoon open.
A fountain machinist and a soap trumpet build a choir of bubbles in a plaza until the trumpet takes a bow.
A lantern telegraphist and a giggle key send sunlight down a funicular until the key unlocks a picnic.
A marble-train captain and a polite throttle drive laughter under a park until the throttle gentles the ride.

categories.name: Thresholds
ideas: A door shepherd and a salt key open a tide inside a train station until the key locks the sea kind.
A threshold swimmer and a pearl hinge pass from a bathtub into a moon harbour until the hinge sings shut.
A bridge novice and a red thread cross from a kitchen into a canyon of birds until the thread holds.
A curtain diver and a brass ring fall through a theatre drape into a real storm until the ring takes a bow.
A gate gardener and a living latch grow a door in a glacier until the latch opens onto summer.
A stair astronomer and a chalk step climb from a cellar into the weather until the step becomes a cloud.
A mirror ferryman and a fog ticket leave a dressing room for a lake of glass until the ticket dissolves.
A window mason and a dawn putty set a pane that turns a night street into morning until the putty warms.
An archway beekeeper and a honey key enter a walled garden that is also the sky until the key hums.
A snow locksmith and a warm coin turn a freezer door into a beach gate until the coin buys the sun.

categories.name: Tiny kingdoms
ideas: A thimble monarch and a pin sceptre rule a kingdom in a coat pocket until the sceptre knights a button.
A crumb cartographer and a sesame compass map a banquet from inside a napkin until the feast cheers.
A dew knight and a grass lance defend a moss courtyard on a windowsill until the lance lifts the morning.
A button admiral and a thread flag sail a teacup across a sunny table until the flag claims the saucer.
A matchstick architect and a spark blueprint build a warm city in a hearth until the blueprint becomes home.
A pebble monk and a rain bowl keep a monastery in a shoe until the bowl overflows with kindness.
A stitch surgeon and a needle lamp heal a torn map on a desk until the lamp shows a tiny coast.
A cork mayor and a bottle gavel open a council inside a green bottle on a pier until the vote is joy.
A lint ballerina and a dust crown dance a court across a sunbeam until the crown catches firelight.
A seed mayor and a leaf stamp found a village in a flowerpot until the stamp greens the whole sill.

categories.name: Noon pollen
ideas: Hard noon, pollen gold, one white shadow on warm stone.
Lemon light, a clean horizon, dust dancing in a shaft.
Butter sun on linen, a single orange flare at the edge.
High summer, chalk walls, a green flash in the corner.
Picnic glare, honey highlights, shadows short and kind.
White sail noon, blue water bounced into every face.
Apricot hour, soft grain, a smile of light on metal.
Citrus wash, open sky, one ripe shadow under the prop.
Wheat glare, air you can see, a bright rim on the hero.
Sunday gold, no gloom, a spark caught in a glass rim.

categories.name: Night copper
ideas: Copper night, one lamp, rain drawn like dark wire.
Low amber, a hallway of smoke, the prop as the only moon.
Burgundy dark, a coin of light, edges almost lost.
Oil-lamp orange against a blue-black room.
Ember practical, deep teal falloff, a hush in the blacks.
Brass night, wet cobbles, a narrow path of warmth.
Mahogany shadow, one candle, the place holding its breath.
Ruby practicals, ink background, a glint on the prop.
Lantern copper, long dark, a doorway just barely there.
Burnt sienna night, a single reflection in black water.

categories.name: Glass water
ideas: Clear caustics, moving light, edges soft as breath.
Aquarium green, a ripple across the whole frame.
Ice glass, pale cyan, one bubble rising through.
Window-rain bokeh, silver streaks, a soft face of light.
Tide-pool clarity, pebbles of colour under the surface.
Steam on glass, a wipe of hand, the world blooming back.
Mercury sheen, cool highlights, a liquid bend in the room.
Bottle-green depth, a shaft from above, slow bright motes.
Frosted pane, diffused white, a hint of blue at the rim.
Harbour glass, doubled reflections, the prop floating twice.

categories.name: Botanical dye
ideas: Leaf-dye green, wet bark, a flare of yellow blossom.
Indigo cloth, sap green shadow, a pink stamen of light.
Madder red on cream, botanical stains, living edges.
Moss velvet, a gold pollen hit, deep shade behind.
Chlorophyll glow, backlit leaves, veins like stained glass.
Berry ink, stained fingers of light, a green relief.
Fern dark, one orchid spot, humid highlights.
Lichen silver, olive midtones, a fresh cut of stem.
Saffron dust on green, a garden seen through gauze.
Pine resin amber, needle green, a bright sap gleam.

categories.name: Storm silver
ideas: Storm silver, a slit of sun, wind you can almost see.
Graphite clouds, a white rip, rain as bright threads.
Cold steel light, blown spray, one warm window left.
Lightning white for a blink, then blue-grey calm.
Pewter sea, a brass glint, weather moving through frame.
Hail glitter, hard side light, the place briefly holy.
Squall green, silver pavement, a flag of light overhead.
Thunder shade, a mercury horizon, edges shaking.
Rain chrome, dark coats of colour, one clean highlight.
Gale-pale sky, iron water, a sudden kindness of sun.

categories.name: Ash ember
ideas: Ash velvet, one ember, smoke slow across the floor.
Charcoal field, a live coal, soft ruin all around.
Soot black, a rose of heat, ash falling like snow.
Cinder orange in a grey world, the prop still warm.
Burnt paper tones, a glow inside the hero's hands.
Kiln dark, hairline cracks of light, quiet after fire.
Ember dust, low contrast, one fierce point of heat.
Smoke brown, a fading spark, the place cooling.
Ash white on black, a coal drawing come alive.
Afterglow red, powder grey, tenderness in the dark.

categories.name: Parade colour
ideas: Parade primaries, confetti dust, a clean white ground.
Flag red, sky blue, a gold laugh of light.
Candy chroma, hard sun, shadows in pure complement.
Balloon gloss, saturated air, joy with sharp edges.
Marching-band brass, scarlet and cream, a cymbal flare.
Fairground bulbs, spinning colour, a sweet overexposure.
Kite silk primaries against a blown-out sky.
Paint-still-wet colour, a cheering wash, no mud.
Ribbon red through sunflower yellow, crisp and loud.
Carnival glass, prism hits, a grin of spectrum.

categories.name: Pale hush
ideas: Pale hush, milk light, a thin blue shadow at the sill.
Bone white, a whisper of pink, almost no contrast.
Fog linen, soft grey, one pearl highlight on the prop.
Chalk room, breath-warm, edges dissolving kindly.
Rice-paper light, a faint green, quiet as cloth.
Porcelain day, low saturation, a single blush.
Mist white, silver midtones, the place barely arriving.
Dove grey, a candle of colour, hush over everything.
Eggshell dawn, pale gold, shadows no darker than dust.
Linen fade, airy, a small bright mercy in the frame.

categories.name: Push and approach
ideas: Push through hanging rain until the prop fills the frame.
Glide in from the door until the hero's hands arrive.
Drift forward on a breath, the place opening ahead.
Creep closer as the prop begins to change.
A steady push, weather sliding off the lens.
Approach low, along the floor, toward a pool of light.
Push past foreground leaves into the hero's eyes.
Slide in beside the hero, matching their pace.
A slow approach that turns into a held stare.
Push until the place falls away and only the prop remains.

categories.name: Orbit
ideas: Orbit the hero once, low, the place sliding behind.
Circle the prop as it turns the other way.
A half orbit that reveals the weather behind them.
Spin slowly, the hero planted, the room a carousel.
Orbit up from the boots to a bright horizon.
Circle through a doorway, losing them, finding them.
A joyful orbit, confetti streaking the edges.
Orbit in the dark, one lamp keeping the hero.
Sweep around until the prop eclipses the hero.
A final orbit that settles into a still profile.

categories.name: Crane and fall
ideas: Crane from the boots to a sky that keeps opening.
Fall with a drop of water from leaf to ground.
Rise off the prop until the place becomes a map.
Drop straight down a stairwell of light.
Crane over a shoulder into the weather ahead.
Sink from a wide sky to the hero's open hands.
Lift through smoke into a hard clean sun.
Fall backward off a ledge into a softer world.
Crane along a table as the prop travels its length.
Rise and rise until the hero is a bright speck.

categories.name: Macro
ideas: Macro on the prop as it splits into living petals.
Fill the frame with a grain of pollen, then the hero.
A bead of water holds the whole place upside down.
Macro on a stitch tightening, the world waiting.
The prop's surface becomes a landscape, then recedes.
Eyelash close, a laugh lighting the skin.
Macro on rust blooming like a flower.
A fingerprint ridge, then the hand that made it.
Dew on metal, the place reduced to one sparkle.
Macro as the prop hatches, tiny and enormous.

categories.name: Weather strike
ideas: A sun-shaft rakes the hero, then the weather turns kind.
Rain arrives sideways and the camera leans with it.
Wind takes the frame, the prop steady at centre.
Snow erases the place, then the hero steps back in.
A bright squall, everyone leaning, the prop held high.
Lightning blinks the room into day for one frame.
Fog pours in low, the hero wading through it.
Hail chatters, the camera flinching, then calming.
A warm gust lifts dust into a gold curtain.
The storm exhales and the place is suddenly gentle.

categories.name: Hands and prop
ideas: Hands turn the prop once, and the room answers.
The hero sets the prop down as if it were alive.
Fingers hover, then commit, the camera holding.
Pass the prop from hand to hand without a cut.
A palm opens and the prop rises on its own.
Hands in joy, the prop tossed and caught in light.
A careful grip in the dark, knuckles the brightest thing.
The prop is offered to camera, then taken back.
Hands build the prop from nothing while we watch.
Let the hands leave, the prop remaining, still warm.

categories.name: Reveal
ideas: Reveal the place by sliding a door of light aside.
Wipe the hero into frame on a passing train of shadow.
Open on the prop, rack to a vast place behind it.
A curtain of rain parts on the hero.
Reveal by reflection, then turn to the real thing.
Start tight on a laugh, widen to the whole bright street.
A dark reveal: the place exists only as the lamp finds it.
The prop swings aside and the journey is behind it.
Reveal the scale by a bird crossing, tiny then gone.
Turn a corner into weather we did not know was there.

categories.name: Release
ideas: Release: the hero lets the prop go and the frame exhales.
Hold, then a small nod, then the camera finally breathes.
The prop settles, the hero steps back into light.
A laugh breaks the tension and the move eases.
Let the weather finish the gesture.
The hero lowers their hands and the place goes quiet.
Release into a wide, joyful, almost still frame.
A last look, then the camera drifts up and away.
The prop clicks home and every motion stops.
Exhale the shot into dawn, or into kind dark.

categories.name: Pour and harden
ideas: Pour the hero into the prop, then harden both in the same place.
The frame melts, runs downhill, and sets as the next shot.
Liquid light fills the hero and freezes into a new pose.
A spill of colour hardens into the place, edges crisp.
The prop liquefies, crosses the cut, and becomes solid again.
Honey-slow pour from one scale into another, then a snap set.
Rain on the lens thickens, then clears as a hard new image.
The hero's outline drips away and reforms, same prop in hand.
Molten joy that cools into a bright, still frame.
A dark pour, cooling to glass, the place locked inside it.

categories.name: Bloom
ideas: The prop opens and the place becomes the flower.
A bud of light blooms across the cut into the next shot.
Petals wipe the frame, the hero waiting in the heart.
One seed pops, and the whole picture is suddenly garden.
A laugh blooms into weather, same hero, wider world.
The prop flowers in the hand and the hand becomes landscape.
Night blooms: a black bud opening onto a single star.
Colour blossoms from the centre and settles as a new palette.
A tight bud of a face opens into the full bright place.
Bloom and hold, the transformation finished, still alive.

categories.name: Ribbon
ideas: A ribbon of water carries the cut to the next scale.
Silk of light wraps the hero and unwraps a new place.
One red ribbon pulls the prop from this shot into the next.
A joyful streamer stitches two frames without a blink.
Smoke ribbon, dark and thin, threading the hero through.
The prop trails a ribbon that becomes the horizon.
A hairline of gold leads the eye across the transformation.
Ribbons of rain braid into the next composition.
A pale ribbon loosens and the picture exhales wider.
Tie the cut with a ribbon, then let it fall away.

categories.name: Tide
ideas: The tide takes the frame and returns it brighter.
A wave of shadow covers the hero and withdraws, changed.
Moon-tide: the picture ebbs to black and floods back.
Waterline rises through the prop and lowers on a new world.
A gentle tide of pollen washes one shot into the next.
The place inhales like a sea and exhales the hero closer.
Foam wipes left to right, leaving a cleaner light.
A dark undertow yanks the scale, then the surface calms.
Tide-pools of the old shot glint inside the new one.
The last wave sets the prop down and goes still.

categories.name: Scale morph
ideas: Shrink the place to the prop, then grow it past the hero.
The hero towers, then is a speck in their own palm.
Zoom through a grain of the prop into a new country.
A city folds into a thimble without losing the hero.
The prop swells until it is the weather.
Drop from a mountain to a freckle in one breath.
Scale up through laughter until the room is a cathedral.
A tiny dark door in the prop opens onto the real place.
Grow the hero from a reflection in a spoon.
End huge and quiet, the journey of size complete.

categories.name: Shatter and gather
ideas: Shatter into seed, then gather back as one object.
The frame cracks like glaze and reassembles kinder.
Confetti burst, then every piece flies home to the prop.
A dark shatter, embers, gathering into a steady lamp.
Glass hero, broken into light, reformed in the same place.
The prop explodes into birds and the birds settle as weather.
Joyful shatter: colour everywhere, then a clean new frame.
Crack, pause, gather, the hero never actually lost.
Ash scatters and draws itself into the next composition.
One last shard clicks in and the picture is whole.

categories.name: Smoke and dew
ideas: Smoke thins to dew on the same prop.
A cloud leaves the hero and beads into bright water.
Incense writes the next shot, then condenses.
Fog gathers into a single drop that is the prop.
Dew climbs back into mist and the place changes inside it.
A warm breath fogs the lens and clears on a new hour.
Night smoke, then morning beads on the hero's sleeve.
The prop smoulders, sighs, and is suddenly jewel-bright.
Haze organises itself into weather with a direction.
Last wisp, one drop, a clean hold.

categories.name: Eclipse
ideas: An eclipse closes, and the hero steps out in new light.
The prop covers the sun of the frame, then slips aside.
A dark disc wipes the picture and leaves a softer day.
Blink of totality, corona, then the place rearranged.
The hero eclipses the prop, and when they part both have changed.
A joyful eclipse: a balloon crossing a lamp, colour after.
Shadow bite, held dark, release into pale gold.
The moon of a hand passes over the lens.
Totality as a tunnel, the far end a different scale.
Light returns in a ring, the transformation done.
